judged_rule: judged is "published" where a v3.26, v3.26.1, v3.26.2 or v3.26.3 summary publishes a Code quality score from both judges (judged_under names the round); the two timed-out rows carry the reason they have none
timeouts_rule: combined_timeouts_zero is the combined score with each timed-out run counted as 0 (harness DECISIONS.md 2026-09-28); for every judged run it equals combined_33
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator; no Muse Wonder Full run needed that rule
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed (a timed-out run reached no verification, so it fixed none)

cost_fields.estimated_usd: main_model_usd plus reminder_usd, an estimate (Meta lists no API price for Muse Wonder Full)
cost_fields.main_model_usd: Muse Wonder Full tokens at the Muse Wonder 1.0 list price
cost_fields.reminder_usd: Muse Code 1.4.9's Muse Spark 1.3 reminder-observer tokens at Muse Spark 1.3's list price; 0 on 1.4.6

token_fields.raw_tokens: Muse Wonder Full input (cached included) plus output, as Muse Code reports it; reminder-observer tokens are recorded apart in reminder_observer_usage

overlap_field: overlap_minutes_logged counts the minutes in which the per-minute overlap log recorded another local benchmark process during the run (a timing caveat; scores are unaffected); the log started with Medium, so Low is null
